items.item_text: BS degree in Immunology/Biological Sciences or related field Preferred.
Experience with methods of disposal and containment of infectious waste.
1-2 years’ work experience in related field.

Skills to operate autoclaves, glassware washers, millipore filters, ovens, laminar flow hoods, biosafety cabinets, fume hoods, centrifuges, ELISA readers and washers, auto and manual pipets, incubators, microscopes, calculators, balances, computers, spectrophotometer and pH meters, tissue processors, embedders, and microtome equipment.
Skills to maintain clean laboratory work areas and laboratory equipment in good working order.

Skills to maintain neat and accurate written and computerized records. Knowledge of UC purchasing procedures and skills to perform appropriate and cost-effective ordering and use of laboratory and/or office supplies and equipment.
Skills to adapt to change and to work in other areas as needed.
Skills to perform literature searches and to organize data for publication.
